propositions: REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_MODEL_ID environment variable and bedrock_model_id config field are parsed and documented but never read by any code except their declaration
The actual Bedrock model ID is carried through cfg.model as a provider-prefixed string (bedrock:<profile-id>) parsed by providers.py, making the separate config knob redundant
Setting REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_MODEL_ID produces no model change, warning, or error — silent failure with no user feedback
The unread field exists only in an unsubmitted change (1043) in an in-flight epic stack and has never shipped to production

Deletion is the correct remediation over wiring because no existing configuration depends on it, cfg.model already provides the working path, and it cannot serve the per-pass model mapping use case it was investigated for
